rationale: With only 19 minutes remaining before the mandatory close liquidation, the wide bid-ask spread of 21.8 bps ($0.06) consumes nearly half of a 5-minute ATR ($0.1247), making the cost of entry and exit too high relative to the remaining intraday range. Furthermore, while the last five 1-minute candles show a steady grind higher above VWAP ($27.43), volume on this push is very light (~2,000 shares per minute) and price is already extended from the 5-minute 9-EMA ($27.26), offering poor risk-reward in either direction.
